svg.title: Saarthi virtual CAN integration
svg.desc: A replay source publishes timestamped vehicle signals onto a python-can virtual bus, a reader decodes them, and a causal aligner and freshness gate decide whether the forecast may use them.

svg.text: Virtual CAN proves the software boundary, not vehicle homologation
The POC exercises message encoding, timing, decoding, alignment, and stale-data behavior without pretending a laptop is a vehicle ECU.
Camera-only mode → CAN is not required
WHAT STILL BELONGS TO PRODUCTION ENGINEERING
OEM DBC · gateway permission · physical interface · ECU timing
ISO 26262 / SOTIF evidence, cybersecurity, environmental and vehicle testing
